0022600032.text: The Los Angeles Lakers (7-2, 4-1 at home, on a three-game winning streak) host the Portland Trail Blazers (6-1, 5-0 on the road, also on a three-game winning streak) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game, the Lakers' 10th of the 2026-27 season. The Lakers sit 1st in the Pacific and 2nd in the West, while Portland leads the Northwest and the West, and the Blazers are without Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery) and Vit Krejci (ankle), all listed as out. The Lakers trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 136-129 at home on October 27, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-2.
